newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Golkar says surprised at win margin.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Golkar says surprised at win margin.

text.p: Indonesia's ruling Golkar party said on Friday it was surprised at the margin of its victory in the general elections.
"It surprises us because according to our calculations we thought we can reach only 70 or 71 percent," Abdul Gafur, one of the seven chairpersons of the party, told Reuters.

Latest returns showed Golkar had won some 74 percent of almost 105 million votes counted. Nearly 125 million people were eligible to vote in Thursday's general elections, but turnout figures were not immediately known.
"We have worked very hard and this is the result," Gafur said.
He said the size of the win would have little effect on the policies of Golkar, which has been in power for most of President Suharto's 30-year tenure.
"Golkar will be in a powerful position in the decision-making process," Gafur said. "But we will avoid any step to be just powerful for the sake of power.
"Golkar will be stronger and more powerful, but within the framework of our political system."
